evidence.excerpt: /api/telemetry/health returned HTTP 200 status=healthy while otelEnabled=false, disabledReason reports missing TELEMETRY_HMAC_SALT, and both traceStore and metricsSnapshotStore are null after 91.74h uptime.
/api/telemetry/traces/stats returned 503 Trace store not available; hold_ball throughput and zombie/cancel samples remain unevaluable.
/api/telemetry/metrics and /api/telemetry/metrics/history returned 503; forced-pass and void-hold rates remain unevaluable despite a 91.74h counter window.
In-process metrics remain unavailable, so serial-route activation and friction counters have no current denominator or trend sample.

/api/telemetry/grounding-samples returned 503 because the telemetry HMAC salt is unavailable and redaction cannot run. grounding.check_total, verdict_total, mismatch_sample_count, and mismatch patterns remain unevaluable; no-data is a telemetry gap, not a healthy distribution.

proposedAction.rationale: The F167 counter-window and grounding hooks exist in source, but the acceptance runtime still does not initialize telemetry. Coordinate the required operator-managed TELEMETRY_HMAC_SALT configuration and acceptance restart, and make health or the eval publish-prerequisite gate report degraded/skip when OTel is disabled instead of emitting unevaluable runs.
